configurePresets.name: cxx
configurePresets.description: Pure-C++ build. FPSAN_ENABLE_HIP=OFF forces the C++ path even if a HIP toolchain happens to be discoverable on this machine. Select the compiler via the usual CC/CXX environment variables or -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=...

configurePresets.name: hip
configurePresets.description: HIP build. The HIP path turns on automatically when a HIP toolchain is found under ROCM_PATH (default /opt/rocm); point at a different install with -DROCM_PATH=... or override -DCMAKE_HIP_COMPILER / -DCMAKE_HIP_COMPILER_ROCM_ROOT directly.

configurePresets.name: hip-gfx950
configurePresets.displayName: HIP C++ (ROCm clang, gfx950 / CDNA4 / MI350)
configurePresets.description: Wave64 (CDNA4). Compile-checks the gfx950 wrappers (MFMA, smfmac, scaled cvt, ds_read_tr). Runtime requires real MI350 hardware (or the rocjitsu simulator).

configurePresets.name: hip-gfx942
configurePresets.displayName: HIP C++ (ROCm clang, gfx942 / CDNA3 / MI300)
configurePresets.description: Wave64 (CDNA3 / MI300). Builds and runs the gfx942-supported wrapper/test surface on MI300-class hardware.

configurePresets.name: hip-gfx1250
configurePresets.description: Wave32 (gfx1250). Compile-checks the gfx1250 WMMA family (K=32/64/128), bf16 transcendentals, and block-scale cvt wrappers. Runtime requires gfx1250 hardware.
